title: Progress Beacon — Personal Metrics & Rituals
body:
Purpose
---
Light-weight personal tracking doc: capture the signals I care about week-to-week, surface hypotheses, and keep a tiny experiment log. Not for org consumption — private scratchpad.

Cadence
---
I’m running a 9-day cadence (Mon start, OOO on day 7 sometimes). Quick check every 3 days, deeper review at cadence end.

Progress Beacon (composite)
---
Why a composite? I want a single quick check to tell me whether I’m trending up/down without losing the nuance.
Beacon score = 0.5*(Deep-work hours / target) + 0.3*(Deliverables shipped / target) + 0.2*(Blocked days ratio reversed)
Target beacon: 0.8+ to feel good. Last cycle: 0.64 -> improvement needed.

Signal metrics (my 3 primary)
1) Focus time (deep work): target 18h / 9-day cadence (2h/day). Last: 12.5h.
2) Deliverable throughput: target 4 small PRs / cycle. Last: 2 merged (INF-4123, INF-4150).
3) Blocked-days ratio: target <= 0.15. Last: 0.22 (two days waiting on infra quota).

Leading indicators (things I can change quickly)
- Calendar hygiene: block 2x 90-min deep blocks (M/W/Th) -> experiment this cycle.
- Pre-reads: write 1-pager before meetings to shorten them.
- Swap complex review pairs earlier in the week so merges don’t pile.

Lagging indicators (what shows up later)
- Number of regressions caught in QA (want decrease).
- Customer-reported latency incidents (aim for 0).

This cycle goals (concrete and measurable)
- Ship the runtime micro-batching doc and PR: target PR + review done by day 6 (linked: https://github.com/redwood/realtime/pull/821).
- Reduce average review turnaround to <36h for my PRs.
- Run two experiments to raise deep-work hours: (a) 90-min blocks, (b) no-meetings Wednesday.

Micro-experiments log
- E1: 90-minute blocks (M/T/Th) — week 1 result: +3.5h deep work, major win. Keep but push first block to 09:00 to catch morning flow.
- E2: Meeting-free Wednesday — blocked on calendar but team had blockers; next iteration add optional sync at 14:00.
- E3: Quick-review checklist in PR description — shaved ~10m per review.

Blockers & hypotheses
- Infra quota (SRE) delays -> hypothesis: move infra requests earlier in the cycle reduces blocked-days by 60%. Action: file INF-4182 pre-week.
- Too many async interruptions -> hypothesis: set Slack status and schedule "office hours" for async questions.

Retrospective notes (last cycle)
- What worked: focused morning block, PR checklist, pairing for complex reviews.
- What didn’t: late infra requests, meetings spilled into deep-work blocks.
- Surprise: a single merged opt-level change reduced median p95 latency by 4ms in internal perf harness (see INF-4123 notes).

Quick progress table (text)
Metric             | Target | Last cycle | Delta
-------------------------------------------
Deep hours         | 18h    | 12.5h      | -5.5h
PRs merged         | 4      | 2          | -2
Blocked days ratio | 0.15   | 0.22       | +0.07
Beacon score       | 0.80   | 0.64       | -0.16

Next actions (this file is my TODO list)
- [ ] File INF-4182: pre-emptive infra quota request (due day 1).
- [ ] Push runtime micro-batching PR to review (github PR linked above).
- [ ] Schedule no-meeting Wednesday (tentative) and notify team.
- [ ] Prep 1-page pre-read for Friday sync about batching heuristics.

Parking lot (ideas, not committed)
- Build a tiny dashboard to compute Beacon score automatically from calendar + dev metrics.
- Try an alternative cadence (6-day focused sprints) for two cycles and compare.
- Track interruptions (count/day) for two weeks to validate "async office hours" hypothesis.

Notes to self
- Keep notes short. When in doubt, move action to Todo list above.
- Share any concrete repeatable wins with team (short postmortem or tips doc).

Open questions
- Is 18h deep-work realistic during high-support weeks? Maybe drop to 14h as a sustainable target.
- How much of the Beacon score should be time-based vs output-based? Revisit weights next month.

Timestamp log (manual)
- 2026-02-20: created, first draft of metrics and beacon formula.
- 2026-03-01: ran E1 experiment, updated deep-work numbers.
- 2026-03-10: consolidated notes and queued INF-4182.

End of scratchpad.
